description: This PHP class 'Base64Attachment' defines validation rules for base64-encoded file attachments, including checks for file type, extension, size, and filename length constraints within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: Base64Attachment
classes.description: A validation rule class for base64-encoded file attachments, ensuring compliance with allowed types, extensions, size, and filename length constraints.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validation rule with allowed types, extensions, filename length constraints, size limit, and strict size checking option.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input array representing a file attachment, checking required fields, type, extension, filename length, size, and content size consistency.

methods.name: validateMin
methods.description: Checks if the filename length meets the minimum length requirement.

methods.name: validateMax
methods.description: Checks if the filename length does not exceed the maximum length requirement.
